summary: NextTrip, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity offering of up to $6.5 million of common stock through agent Titan Partners Securities LLC. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under an existing sales agreement, not a special situation. The agent receives a 3.5% commission and the company will use proceeds for general purposes. No special-situation elements such as acquisitions, spin-offs, or restructuring are present. The filing is purely a capital-raising mechanism, so it does not qualify as a special situation.
